name: code-review-checklist-agent
description: PSSM2.0 Code Review Checklist Agent — conversational AI that generates, analyses and tracks code review checklists from GitHub PRs and Jira stories

chatParticipants.name: checklist
chatParticipants.description: Generates a filled PSSM2.0 code review checklist Excel from PR comments

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a filled checklist Excel for a PR. Usage: @checklist /generate <PR_URL>

commands.name: token
commands.description: Save, check, or clear your GitHub PAT. Usage: @checklist /token <PAT> | status | clear

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show all checklist versions for a PR. Usage: @checklist /history <PR_URL>

commands.name: jira
commands.description: Save Jira credentials. Usage: @checklist /jira <email> <token> | status | clear

commands.name: list
commands.description: Batch mode: resolve Jira keys/PR URLs and generate checklists. Usage: @checklist /generate --list SRM2-1234 SRM2-5678 https://github.com/org/repo/pull/42
